title: DDE SDTM methods library
description: Standard SDTM derivation methods the methods loader (src/loaders/methods) attaches to Derived items in a DDS. 'methods' holds finished, shared methods (MSG v2 style, generic -- text, OIDs without a domain); 'assignments' says which items get each one. A method entry is a DDS Method in the ODM v2.0 shape proposed as PR-DDS-3 (DDS_FOR_METHODS.md), plus the library-only 'basis'. The slot names are frozen to PR-DDS-3 and pinned by src/loaders/methods/tests; this schema is the interim check until DataExchange-DDS model/dds.yaml carries them. See 'Plan SDTM MethodDef Loader for the DDS.md'.

schemaVersion.description: The library format version, MAJOR.MINOR. The loader refuses an unknown major version.

methods.description: Method definitions. A later file that defines the same OID replaces the earlier entry as a whole.

assignments.description: Which Derived items get which method. Ranked like defaults entries: exact name, then longer suffix, then shorter suffix, then *; then a where match, then a domain filter; then a later file.

method.description: A DDS Method (ODM v2.0 MethodDef). Define-XML 2.1 output keeps OID, name, type, description, inline expressions and documents, and drops the signature and ExternalCodeLib expressions.

type.description: Define-XML 2.1 rule 209 allows Computation and Imputation only; both are also ODM v2.0 MethodType values.

description.description: Define-XML 2.1 rules 56 and 210: a non-empty description. A string, or a DDS TranslatedText.

basis.description: Library only, never written to the DDS: where the wording and the signature come from.

signature.description: PR-DDS-3 MethodSignature (ODM v2.0 MethodDef/MethodSignature): the method's named, typed and ordered inputs and outputs. ODM v2.0 requires one on every MethodDef; the loader writes an empty one for an entry without it.

parameter.description: DDS Parameter with PR-DDS-3 orderNumber (ODM v2.0 Parameter: Name, DataType, Definition, OrderNumber).

OID.description: DDS identifier (Parameter, ReturnValue and FormalExpression are IdentifiableElements, so the generated DDS JSON Schema requires it). Optional here: the loader generates PA.<method>.<name> when absent. ODM v2.0 has no such OID, so an ODM v2.0 export drops it.

returnValue.description: DDS ReturnValue with PR-DDS-3 orderNumber (ODM v2.0 ReturnValue: Name, DataType, Definition, OrderNumber).

OID.description: DDS identifier (Parameter, ReturnValue and FormalExpression are IdentifiableElements, so the generated DDS JSON Schema requires it). Optional here: the loader generates RV.<method>.<name> when absent. ODM v2.0 has no such OID, so an ODM v2.0 export drops it.

expression.description: DDS FormalExpression with exactly one body: inline code (expression, ODM v2.0 Code) or an externalCodeLib reference (PR-DDS-3). context is required (Define-XML 2.1 rule 221).

OID.description: DDS identifier (Parameter, ReturnValue and FormalExpression are IdentifiableElements, so the generated DDS JSON Schema requires it). Optional here: the loader generates FE.<method>.<n> when absent. ODM v2.0 has no such OID, so an ODM v2.0 export drops it.

document.description: DDS DocumentReference for a supporting document: its leaf ID and optional integer (physical) pages.

dataType.description: The DDS DataType enum (schemas/dds/dds.yaml) plus the seven ISO 8601 types PR-DDS-3 adds (DDS_FOR_METHODS.md change 7, D5).

name.description: The Derived item's name. A leading -- matches any longer name that ends with the rest (--SEQ matches LBSEQ). * matches every item and needs domains.

method.description: OID of a method some loaded library file defines.

where.description: Value-level only: {variable: value} matches a value-level item whose where clause admits the value (EQ equal, or IN listing it), e.g. {"VSTESTCD": "BMI"}.

description.description: A note on why the assignment exists.
